title: A Quantum Coherence Corpus
author: Ethan James Farrell
description: A collection exploring quantum coherence and its wider conceptual connections with consciousness and spiritual inquiry. It offers a starting point for considering how ideas from different fields are brought into conversation.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. One format was converted from the other (PDF from EPUB).
